sections.heading: Saif Ali Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Saif Ali Khan was born on 16 August 1970 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Sajid Ali Khan Pataudi at birth and is publicly known as Saif Ali Khan.
Public records name his father, Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi and his mother, Sharmila Tagore. He is a sibling of Saba Ali Khan and Soha Ali Khan.
His listed education includes Winchester College, The Lawrence School, Sanawar and Lockers Park School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
